server_url.title: Mindcraft server URL
server_url.description: WebSocket address of the Mindcraft server

agent_name.title: Bot name
agent_name.description: Name of the bot in Mindcraft. It matches the name field in andy.json

api_key.title: API KEY
api_key.description: OpenAI-compatible API key for the Mindcraft bot. It is written to GAME/Minecraft/keys.json

model_name.title: Model name
model_name.description: Model used by the Mindcraft bot, for example gemini-2.0-flash

model_url.title: Model URL
model_url.description: OpenAI-compatible API address, for example https://api.zhizengzeng.com/v1

conversing.title: Bot persona
conversing.description: System prompt of the Mindcraft bot. It is written to the conversing field in andy.json
